angle.hook: a tiny mouse's open-world adventure Hela: of Mice & Magic now has a firm launch date, 1 Dec 2026, on five platforms
angle.why_now: launch is 17 days away; the publisher's date announcement of 9 Sep and the Steam page confirm it, the Arabic press has not covered it and Steam lists no Arabic
angle.what_it_means_here: Gulf players on Switch 2, PS5, Xbox and PC can plan for 1 Dec; Arabic is not among Steam's supported languages and no price is shown on Steam
angle.payoff: a limited physical Harmony Edition with a 48-page art book and map poster for Switch 2, PS5 and Xbox Series X only
